description: This file is a PHP source file that generates the web interface for configuring local IP settings of a network device, including IPv4 and IPv6 configurations, DHCP settings, IP addresses, subnet masks, and ULA prefixes. It includes server-side PHP code and client-side JavaScript for dynamic form handling and validation.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Converts lease time values based on units (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, forever) into seconds or special value (-1 for forever).

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Converts numeric lease time in seconds into human-readable form and updates the corresponding form fields, selecting appropriate units.

methods.name: display_time_format_V6
methods.description: Performs similar function as display_time_format but for IPv6 lease times.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string into an array of its hextet components, handling compressed notation (::).

methods.name: updateIPv6
methods.description: Updates form controls based on IPv6 Address State (Stateless or Stateful).

methods.name: stateful_check
methods.description: Toggles IPv6 ULA address inputs based on the Stateful checkbox status.

methods.name: validate_v4addr_pool
methods.description: Checks whether the DHCP beginning address is less than or equal to the ending address.

methods.name: validate_v6addr_pool
methods.description: Checks whether the IPv6 DHCP beginning address is less than or equal to the ending address.

methods.name: setIPconfiguration
methods.description: Sends the IPv4 configuration JSON to the backend PHP handler to set the IPv4 network settings.

methods.name: setIPv6configuration
methods.description: Sends the IPv6 configuration JSON to the backend PHP handler to set the IPv6 network settings.
